newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lisnave expects restructuring news soon.
newsitem.headline: Lisnave expects restructuring news soon.

text.p: Ship repair concern Lisnave-Estaleiros Navais de Lisbon expects to have news soon on negotiations with the Portuguese government on a restructuring, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.
"The process is still in the negotiation phase but decisions should emerge soon," the spokesman said.
The company had been asked to comment on a report in the Diario de Noticias that an emergency plan for the troubled firm would be announced "within days."
Lisnave stock has been one of the most active on the Lisbon bourse in recent sessions. The shares were gaining a further 18 escudos at 431 escudos on Wednesday.
